create_dog_skin: create skin mesh and bone weights for a MuJoCo dog model from an MJCF model and skin mesh asset
generate_capsule_vertices: generate capsule geometry vertices by combining hemisphere and cylinder vertex positions for a given radius and height
generate_ellipsoid_vertices: generate ellipsoid geometry vertices by scaling a unit sphere vertex grid by the given size vector
generate_box_vertices: generate box geometry vertices by sampling surface points across a given width, height, and depth
export_skin_binary: export a MuJoCo skin asset to a binary .skn file with vertex positions, faces, texture coordinates, and bone weights
